fusions.name: Threading Spike
fusions.desc: A thrown spike that deals 36 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Fine Stitching
fusions.desc: Looses 5 fine spines in a tight spread, each dealing 4 damage. Each spine's damage rises 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 20%.

fusions.name: Gap Finder
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Keen Instinct
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. Your abilities come round 5% sooner.
